description: Get ONE register entry by its stable ID, with the full record: verbatim quote, sources, counter-evidence, grade rationale, forecast criterion and outcome, history, and the canonical page URL. Get IDs from search_claims, compare_forecasts, due_forecasts or list_due. IDs look like SGX-AI-000031, SGX-HU-000016, SGX-PE-000056 or SGX-CO-000018 (case-insensitive); unknown or internal IDs return an error. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

id.description: Stable Signetex entry ID: SGX-, area code (AI, HU, PE or CO), dash, six digits. Example: SGX-AI-000031.

name: get_entry
